scripts.all: pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test-fix && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run diy:check && pnpm run knip
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm --dir e2e-tests/success/module-graph run e2e && bash e2e-tests/all.sh
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json knip.json tsconfig.packages.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json oxlint-plugin-local.mjs scripts packages e2e-tests
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json knip.json tsconfig.packages.json .oxlintrc.json .oxfmtrc.json oxlint-plugin-local.mjs scripts packages e2e-tests
